display_title: Even a Hopeless Romantic Wants to Be Loved!
description:
Tae Young-woon, a hopeless romantic who always ends up getting dumped. Then, a woman with unbelievable beauty appears before her! Things going strangely well only makes it even more suspicious?! Will she really be able to get a girlfriend this time…?

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Aladin Tobe](https://tobe.aladin.co.kr/s/26400), [Aladin](https://www.aladin.co.kr/shop/wproduct.aspx?ItemId=376322215), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/6121000523)
